status: finite batches specified before their execution; later diagnostic and nominal-hit amendments labelled; exploratory, not preregistered
correction: Audio-Tactile minus participant × Condition × Phase Baseline mean
curve_weights: equal distance means; trial-count-weighted logistic sensitivity
tests: paired t / equivalent one-df RM ANOVA
categorical_distance: univariate RM ANOVA with GG sphericity adjustment and multivariate Hotelling test
p_values: unadjusted; GG is a sphericity adjustment, not a multiple-testing correction
shape_refits: 500 two-level participant/trial bootstraps, primary40, mean, registered, unsmoothed, all five families, both baseline corrections; stability intervals, not validated coverage
prediction: leave-one-distance-out, every primary40 cell, raw/pooled/same-label; constant/linear/log-distance/five sigmoid families

bayesian.joint_likelihood: original Baseline and Audio-Tactile; corrected curve = AT expectation minus Baseline expectation
bayesian.primary: hierarchical Gaussian logistic, random participant coefficients for all four factorial contrasts
bayesian.diagnostic_extension: up to 6000 tuning / 12000 retained draws per chain, target accept .99; numerical extensions only for failed diagnostics; retain failures
bayesian.gate: rank Rhat <= 1.01, bulk/tail ESS >= 400 for target contrasts, no divergences

stopping: complete this finite battery and diagnostic-driven extensions, regardless of effect direction/p value
limits: No causal mediation, positive-amplitude requirement, forced plateau, negative-RT log transform, or significance-selected cleaning. Native execution only.

numerical_checks.continuous_refinement: all five families × both baseline corrections × four cohorts; unsmoothed means on registered axis; finer 121×81 grid and bounded continuous multistart least squares
numerical_checks.matched_noise_recovery: 20 replicates each: flat, null80, known80, known200 ms amplitudes; retained counts/noise; known midpoint effects +10,-10,+15cm; log-width effects +.15,-.15,+.2
numerical_checks.joint_recovery: one null80 and one known200 dataset; diagnostic rather than repeated coverage validation
numerical_checks.bayesian_cv: 20 held-distance refits: constant, linear, log-distance and hierarchical logistic; independent baseline calibration retained; four chains 1500/1500, diagnostic extension 3000 tune/6000 draws
numerical_checks.tie_rule: neutral-shape order within max(1e-8,1e-10 × centered weighted sum of squares) objective tolerance
numerical_checks.nominal_hit_audit: post hoc: all three nominal-hit specifications, continuous refinement plus 500 refits; all six contrasts retained; no new confirmatory claim
numerical_checks.marginal_model: post hoc nuisance-pooling sensitivity after primary sampling difficulties; independent N(0,.2) corrected intercept and N(0,.15) amplitude (seconds), integrated analytically; original shape hierarchy
numerical_checks.heterogeneous_model: post hoc cell-specific LogNormal(log(.12),.5) residual scales after visual inspection of unequal cell noise; independent nuisance model and same shape priors; all experimental contrasts retained
numerical_checks.robust_RT_followup: post hoc Student-t constant, linear and log-distance counterparts to check the RT-level interaction suggested by the Student-t sigmoid; all level/distance effects, including population fixed coefficients, retained; 1500 tune/draw initially, 3000 tune/6000 draws only if diagnostics require
